title: EG4 · Solar Strings & Inverter
description: EG4 12000XP per-MPPT (PV1/PV2) detail and inverter health, from EG4's cloud via lux-mon (luxmon_register, Flux).

links.title: Energy
links.tooltip: EG4 · Energy — daily, monthly and lifetime energy

panels.title: Data freshness
panels.description: Time since lux-mon last wrote an EG4 cloud snapshot (register 'soc', looks back 7 days, always relative to now, ignores the time picker). Live < 5 min, Delayed 5-15 min, Stale >= 15 min. EG4 publishes every ~1-2 min, sometimes up to 5 min, so short Delayed blips can be normal; Stale means every number on this dashboard is old. EG4's own upload lag (typically under a minute) is not included.

panels.title: PV1 power
panels.description: Latest PV1 (MPPT 1) input power, with its trend over the selected range. Source: EG4 cloud via lux-mon; a new point arrives only when EG4 publishes (about every 1-5 min), so values can lag the inverter by a few minutes.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "luxmon")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "luxmon_register" and r.name == "pv1_power" and r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "PV1"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

panels.title: String share today
panels.description: Share of today's solar energy (since local midnight, America/Los_Angeles) produced by each MPPT. Estimated from 5-minute mean power because EG4's cloud reports no per-string kWh; always today, independent of the time picker. Covers only what lux-mon recorded today. Empty until the strings produce after midnight.

targets.query:
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "America/Los_Angeles")

// Energy share per MPPT since local midnight, from 5-min mean power.
// (EG4's cloud has no per-string kWh counter.)
from(bucket: "luxmon")
  |> range(start: today())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "luxmon_register" and (r.name == "pv1_power" or r.name == "pv2_power") and r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["name"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({k: "today", s: if r.name == "pv1_power" then "PV1" else "PV2", _value: r._value}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["k"], columnKey: ["s"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.PV1 and exists r.PV2 and r.PV1 + r.PV2 > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({PV1: 100.0 * r.PV1 / (r.PV1 + r.PV2), PV2: 100.0 * r.PV2 / (r.PV1 + r.PV2)}))

panels.title: String power
panels.description: DC input power per MPPT: PV1 vs PV2. Mean per display interval; gaps longer than 10 min are real feed outages and are left blank. Source: EG4 cloud via lux-mon; a new point arrives only when EG4 publishes (about every 1-5 min), so values can lag the inverter by a few minutes.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "luxmon")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "luxmon_register" and (r.name == "pv1_power" or r.name == "pv2_power") and r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: if r.name == "pv1_power" then "PV1" else "PV2"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: String voltage
panels.description: DC voltage per MPPT: PV1 vs PV2. Voltage with ~0 W is normal at dawn, dusk and night (too little light to harvest); in full sun it means the string is being curtailed (battery full, low load). Gaps > 10 min are feed outages. Source: EG4 cloud via lux-mon; a new point arrives only when EG4 publishes (about every 1-5 min), so values can lag the inverter by a few minutes.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "luxmon")

panels.title: String current
panels.description: Derived DC current per MPPT, I = P / V from the mean power and voltage in each interval (the cloud does not report string current). 0 A when the string voltage is ~0; blank where either input is missing. Source: EG4 cloud via lux-mon; a new point arrives only when EG4 publishes (about every 1-5 min), so values can lag the inverter by a few minutes.

panels.title: Solar by hour of day
panels.description: Average solar output (PV1 + PV2) for each local clock hour, averaged over the days in the selected range; mean W over an hour equals Wh produced in that hour. Hours with no production are omitted. History starts 2026-05-08. Widen the range (e.g. 30 days) for a typical day. Brighter = more energy.

targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "America/Los_Angeles")

// Mean solar power (PV1 + PV2) in each local clock hour, then averaged per
// hour-of-day over the days in range. Mean W over one hour = Wh in that hour.
from(bucket: "luxmon")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "luxmon_register" and (r.name == "pv1_power" or r.name == "pv2_power") and r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({hour: date.hour(t: r._time), _value: r._value}))
  |> group(columns: ["hour"])
  |> mean()
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= 1.0)
  |> sort(columns: ["hour"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({k: "avg", h: (if r.hour < 10 then "0" else "") + string(v: r.hour) + ":00", _value: r._value}))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["k"], columnKey: ["h"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["k"])

panels.title: Inverter mode
panels.description: Inverter working-mode register (state). 192 = normal off-grid operation (PV + battery). Other known off-grid modes are green; standby and AC-input (generator) modes amber; fault red. An unknown code is shown raw as 'code N' in orange. Labels follow lux-mon's working-mode table (collector/outputs.py). Source: EG4 cloud via lux-mon; a new point arrives only when EG4 publishes (about every 1-5 min), so values can lag the inverter by a few minutes.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "luxmon")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "luxmon_register" and r.name == "state" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Mode"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

panels.title: Cloud status
panels.description: EG4 portal's own status text for the inverter (luxmon_cloud.status_text). 'normal' is green; fault/offline wording red; standby amber; anything else is shown as-is in orange.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "luxmon")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "luxmon_cloud" and r._field == "status_text")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
